item.title: 【Requests】[REQ AUD] - Miss Kittin and Golden Boy - Rippin Kittin EP (Big Little Lies Song) - FLAC / Apple Lossless / WAV
item.description:
Hello, I'm requesting the following EP by Miss Kittin and Golden Boy for their single "Rippin Kittin". It was featured in the first season of HBO's Big Little Lies, and the album it is on is hard to find and request via Library. Even so, the album version is mixed, and while I would appreciate a link to the album in FLAC/Hi-Res, I am specifically looking for the EP which features the single version of the song with a clean intro and no fade mix to the next song.

Here is is available on Apple Music France. The single version appears to be 4:48min.

https://music.apple.com/fr/album/rippin-kittin-with-miss-kittin-ep/1032741802

I am requesting this in ALAC or other lossless formats (FLAC / WAV). I am fine with a direct m4a version as well, but would really appreciate it in lossless.
